- 5 programs from 1.6 to 6 years

## Facilities
- Mom & Me (1.6–2 yrs)
- Playschool (2–3 yrs)
- Nursery (3–4 yrs)
- Junior KG (4–5 yrs)
- Senior KG (5–6 yrs)
- Day care
- After school care
- Holiday camps
- Summer programs
- Educational workshops
- Family events

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Maple Seed Academy?
Ram Nagar South Extension, 10th Main Road, Pallikaranai, Chennai 600 100.

### What facilities does Maple Seed Academy have?
Mom & Me (1.6–2 yrs), Playschool (2–3 yrs), Nursery (3–4 yrs), Junior KG (4–5 yrs), Senior KG (5–6 yrs), Day care, After school care, Holiday camps, Summer programs, Educational workshops, Family events.

### What ages do you take?
From 1.6 years (Mom & Me) up to 6 years (Senior KG), plus day care.

### Is it Montessori?
Our programs are rooted in Montessori-based principles, and our curriculum director is an AMI-certified Montessori teacher.

### How do I apply to Maple Seed Academy?
Pick a date in the visit section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 97893 74104. After the visit, you join the Maple Seed family.
